visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brownish hair and a light pink shirt is speaking directly, framed in a medium close-up shot. Behind her is a studio setting featuring a bright yellow neon sign with the Chinese characters "理科". The lighting is professional and bright, emphasizing her facial expressions. (2) The visual cuts to another woman with long black hair, wearing a pink tweed jacket and a necklace, speaking from a side-view perspective in a medium shot. The background is a simple, neutral-colored wall. (3) The sequence continues with frequent cuts between the two women in a shot-reverse-shot style, capturing their conversation. The first woman uses expressive hand gestures, raising her index fingers while emphasizing the word "livestreamer." (4) The camera focuses on the woman in the tweed jacket as she speaks with a sincere expression. White subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom center of the frame throughout the entire video, synchronized with their speech.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 直播在很多人的觀念裡面. (2) [Subtitle]: 是不好的一個工作. (3) [Subtitle]: 會有一個「直播主」. (4) [Subtitle]: 而且加上我有一個 Title 被人家所謂「名媛」這件事情. (5) [Subtitle]: 所以我要光做這件事情 就會被很多女生的朋友 甚至是老的朋友. (6) [Subtitle]: 會有一點點瞧不起. (7) [Subtitle]: 你有感覺到被瞧不起嗎. (8) [Subtitle]: 當然 他會疏遠你. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以你就一定會跨出你的舒適圈 你會覺得說 他們講的話並沒有那麼重要. (10) [Subtitle]: 觀眾在看你的時候 「你為什麼要做直播？」「你不是名媛嗎？」. (11) [Subtitle]: 就算是檯面上的名媛 他們還是希望他們的私生活低調. (12) [Subtitle]: 這些人就會遠離我啊. (13) [Subtitle]: 當我選擇做這份工作的時候 我就必須要有這個心理準備說. (14) [Subtitle]: 我的人生會變 我的朋友會變 我的舒適圈會變 但是我覺得是更好的.
